definition.description: Defines parameters for a new webhook integration.

auth.description: Authentication configuration for the target service.
auth.name: auth

definition.description:
Authentication configuration for creating a webhook integration.
Only one authentication method should be provided.
If null, no authentication will be used.
definition.name: CreateWebhookAuthInput

body.description:
JSON body template.
Use available fields with '$' prefix to define the webhook payload.
See 'Understanding the JSON Fields for Alert Integrations' Knowledge Base
article for details.
body.name: body

relatedWebhookRef.description: Related webhook that provides the Correlation ID used for updates
relatedWebhookRef.name: relatedWebhookRef

by.description:
Specify the webhook integration by name or by ID.
IDs are automatically unique, if you use a non-unique name,
it will result in an error.
by.name: by

requestMethod.description: HTTP method used when sending the webhook request (e.g., POST, PUT).
requestMethod.name: requestMethod

responseMapping.description:
Defines JSON path mappings used to extract values from the webhook response payload.
At present, only a single mapping is supported, with the key "correlationId".
The value must be a valid JSON path pointing to the field in the response payload that represents the correlation identifier (for example, result.sys_id).
responseMapping.name: responseMapping

url.description: The URL of the target service
url.name: url
